question: Which asterisms shine under their names?
premises: other phalgu, caitra, magha, tisya, former phalgu, karna, hundred physicians shine
in mula prajapati, visakha-related by sravana name lusters hold their light
inference: Named asterisms shine each in its station.
uncertainties: naksatra list kept per gloss; bhani subject open
